## Functional characterisation of genes {.tabset}
Here I functionally characterise the high turnover genes to determine whether they can have an affect on the traits they have a relationship with. I do not focus on the unreliable ones because they are likely driven by outliers. 
The functional characterisation involved looking at which tissues the high turnover genes are expressed in, using data from Bgee. Then I look at expression of these genes at the single cell level during embryonic development in zebrafish, followed by contrasting the expression in post embryonic development. I then look for specificity of expression of the genes during metamorphosis in clownfish and grouper. Lastly, I analyse perturbation data of the modules of which the high turnover genes are members of using the ZFIN database.  
Collectively, this section tells me whether the genes are expressed in the relevant cell and tissue types where we predicted an association with a particular phenotype, how they function during embryonic and post embryonic development, and whether there is any specificity in their activity during metamorphosis.

```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-001, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/"}

meta_exp_cafe_genes <- function(species, orthogroup){
  #dge_keep = grouper$dge_keep
  
  make_plot <- function(dge_keep, orthogroup, species, rects = list()) {
    danio_genes_modules_annot %>% left_join(Danio_biomart %>% dplyr::select(`Gene stable ID`, `Gene name`), by=c("orths"="Gene stable ID")) %>% distinct(orths, .keep_all = TRUE)->gene_annot
    
    samp <- dge_keep$samples %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("samples")
    
    df <- dge_keep$counts %>%
      edgeR::cpm(log = TRUE, prior.count = 1e-5, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE) %>%
      reshape2::melt() %>%
      dplyr::rename(orths = Var1, samples = Var2, logCPM = value) %>%
      left_join(samp, by = "samples") %>%
      dplyr::rename(stages = group) %>%
      summarise(mean_logCPM = mean(logCPM, na.rm = TRUE),
                       .by = c(orths, stages)) %>% group_by(orths) %>%
      mutate(z.score = (mean_logCPM - mean(mean_logCPM))/sd(mean_logCPM)) %>%
      ungroup() %>% left_join(orth %>% filter(sp == species) %>%
          dplyr::select(Orthogroup, orths) %>% mutate(orths = stringr::str_remove(orths, "\\.[0-9]*")),
        by = "orths")
  
    p <- df %>% left_join(gene_annot, by = c("Orthogroup")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Orthogroup == orthogroup) %>%
      ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = stages, y = z.score)) +
      facet_wrap(~`Gene name`) +
      geom_line(aes(group = orths.x, color = orths.x), linewidth = 0.6) +
      ggsci::scale_color_nejm() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
            strip.text.x.top = element_text(size=7), legend.position = "none")
    
    # add the rectangles for the metamorphosis transitions
    for (r in rects) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::annotate(
        geom = "rect",
        xmin = r$xmin, xmax = r$xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = r$fill %||% "#594BE4",
        alpha = r$alpha %||% 0.2
      )
    }
    
    p
  }
  

  if (species == "Amphiprion_ocellaris") {
    make_plot(
      dge_keep = clown$dge_keep,
      orth = orthogroup,
      species = species,
      rects = list(list(xmin = 4.5, xmax = 5.5, alpha = 0.2, fill = "#594BE4"))
    )
    
  } else if (species == "Epinephelus_malabaricus") {
    make_plot(
      dge_keep = grouper$dge_keep,
      orth = orthogroup,
      species = species,
      rects = list(
        list(xmin = 1.5, xmax = 2.5, alpha = 0.15, fill = "#594BE4"),
        list(xmin = 5.5, xmax = 6.5, alpha = 0.15, fill = "#594BE4")
      )
    )
    
  } 
}

```

### Zebrahub UMAPS
These plots are present in zonodo. They are large and take too long to render. 
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-004, eval=FALSE}
######## Plot the UMAPS for the genes ##########

danio_genes_modules_annot<-danio_genes_modules %>% filter(gene %in% homologous_genes$genes) %>% left_join(homologous_genes, by=c("gene"="genes")) %>% dplyr::select(gene, orths, mod) %>% left_join(module_annot, by="mod") %>% filter(gene %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% filter(mod_type=="Homologous" & is_sig=="y") %>% pull(genes)))


umap_gene_exp<-function(stage,process) {  
  zhub_dat<-readRDS(paste0("../For_submission/Teleost_convergence/RDS/zhub_",stage,"_log.rds"))
  #danio_conv<-danio_biomart_orth_mods %>% filter(gene %in% (cafe_genefamily_outs %>% 
   #                                               filter(mod=="black") %>% 
    #                                              pull(genes)))
  #danio_conv<-tibble(`Gene name`=c("ndrg4","otx2b"))
  danio_muscle<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Muscle system") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_matrix<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Extracellular matrix and cartilage development 2") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_rna1<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="RNA processing 1") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_rna2<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="RNA processing 2") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_dna<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="DNA replication") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_immune<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Immune system") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_nutrient<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Nutrient absorption") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_brush<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Brush border epithelium development") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_synapse1<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Synaptic signalling 1") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_synapse2<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Synaptic signalling 2") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_peroxi<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Peroxisome process") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_cellcylce<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Cell cycle process") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_resp<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Aerobic respiration") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_neuron<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Neuron migration and placode development") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_tranl1<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Translation") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_tranl2<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Translation 2") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_ribo<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Ribosome related") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_protcat<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Protein catabolism") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_hormone<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Hormone response") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_blood<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Blood related") %>% pull(orths)))
  danio_protfold<-Danio_biomart %>% filter(`Gene stable ID` %in% (danio_genes_modules_annot %>% filter(annot=="Protein folding") %>% pull(orths)))

  
  rowData(zhub_dat)$marker_class <- ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_muscle$`Gene name`, "Muscle system",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_matrix$`Gene name`, "Extracellular matrix and cartilage development 2",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_rna1$`Gene name`, "RNA processing 1",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_rna2$`Gene name`, "RNA processing 2",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_dna$`Gene name`, "DNA replication",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_immune$`Gene name`, "Immune system",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_nutrient$`Gene name`, "Nutrient absorption",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_brush$`Gene name`, "Brush border epithelium development",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_synapse1$`Gene name`, "Synaptic signalling 1",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_synapse2$`Gene name`, "Synaptic signalling 2",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_peroxi$`Gene name`, "Peroxisome process",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_cellcylce$`Gene name`, "Cell cycle process",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_resp$`Gene name`, "Aerobic respiration",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_neuron$`Gene name`, "Neuron migration and placode development",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_tranl1$`Gene name`, "Translation",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_tranl2$`Gene name`, "Translation 2",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_ribo$`Gene name`, "Ribosome related",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_protcat$`Gene name`, "Protein catabolism",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_hormone$`Gene name`, "Hormone response",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_blood$`Gene name`, "Blood related",
                                    ifelse(rownames(zhub_dat) %in% danio_protfold$`Gene name`, "Protein folding",
                                           "other")))))))))))))))))))))
  
  # UMAP colored by expression for all markers - plotReducedDim
  plot_list  <- lapply(rownames(zhub_dat)[rowData(zhub_dat)$marker_class == process], function(x){
    p <- plotReducedDim(zhub_dat, 
                        dimred = 'X_umap',
                        colour_by = x,
                        by_exprs_values = "logcounts",
                        point_size = 0.4)+
      scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "D",direction = -1)+
      xlab("UMAP1")+
      ylab("UMAP2")+
      labs(color = x)+
      theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank())
    return(p)
  })
  
  #Use this to make a single plot with all the genes
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list) %>% ggsave(filename = paste0("./09.Zhub/gene_UMAP_",stage,"_",process,".pdf"),device = "pdf",
                                                      width = 20, height = 15, units = "in", limitsize = F)
  
  #save individual plots
  #names(plot_list)<-rownames(zhub_dat)[rowData(zhub_dat)$marker_class == tissue]
  #for (name in names(plot_list)) {
  #  plot_file_name <- paste0(name, ".pdf")  # Create file name
  #  ggsave(filename = paste0("./Plots/Zhub/individual_gene_plots/",stage,"_",name,"_",tissue,".pdf"), 
  #         plot = plot_list[[name]], 
  #         device = "pdf",
  #         width = 4, height = 3, units = "in", limitsize = F)
  #  }
  
}
```

### Funtional analyses {.tabset}

#### Translation process {.tabset}
Variation in gene copies in the translation module is linked with variation in age of maturity, bodyshape, and aspect ratio. 

##### Expression in Bgee. 
No clear pattern of specific gene expression as the genes are expressed across multiple tissue systems.
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-005, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
phylo_bgee_plot(col = "pink")
```

```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-006, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
 bgee_cafe_genes_plots(orths_in = (cafe_sig %>% filter(mod=="pink") %>% pull(genes)),
                       system = "Translation",
                       slice_size = 10,ncol = 4,nrow =4)
```

##### Expression during embryonic and post-embryonic development
These genes have high expression at 24hpf during embryogenesis, and high expression in later stages of post-embryonic development. 
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-007, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
comp_dev_danio_heatmap(system_proc = "Translation")
```

##### Expression during metamorphosis
In clownfish, the genes generally have a reduced expression during the developmental transition but then have high expression following the thyroid hormone peak. In grouper, the expression of hese genes usually coincides with the peaks of thyroid hormone. 
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-008, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", eval=FALSE}
purrr::map2(.x="Amphiprion_ocellaris", 
            .y=(cafe_sig %>% filter(mod=="pink") %>% pull(genes)),
            ~meta_exp_cafe_genes(species = .x, orthogroup = .y))->clown_meta_cafe_exp
purrr::map2(.x="Epinephelus_malabaricus", 
            .y=(cafe_sig  %>% filter(mod=="pink") %>% pull(genes)),
            ~meta_exp_cafe_genes(species = .x, orthogroup = .y))->grouper_meta_cafe_exp
```

##### ZFIN data
There is not much genetic perturbation data for genes in the translation module. For the genes with available data I see that genetic perturbation has multiple phenotypic effects. They range from arresting development of immune cells, decreasing blood cell count, to decrease in whole body morphology. 
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-010, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/"}
pheno_terms_plot(col = "pink")
```


#### Synaptic signalling {.tabset}
Variation in gene copies in the Synaptic signalling module is linked with variation in growth coefficient, aspect ratio, and lower jaw length. 

##### Expression in Bgee
High expression in brain and eye, with additional expression in muscle and bone. 


```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-012, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
                       system = "Translation",
                       slice_size = 10,ncol = 4,nrow =4)
```

##### Expression during embryonic and post-embryonic development
Overall low expression during embryonic development, with a peak at 3dpf. In posr=t-embryonic, there is high expression during the earlier stages which then reduced as the fish matures. 
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-013, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
comp_dev_danio_heatmap(system_proc = "Synaptic signalling 1")
```

##### Expression during metamorphosis
In clownfish expression peaks coincide with stages where thyroid hormone levels are high.  
In grouper thee expression also coincides with the double peaks of thyroid hormone level.



#### Aerobic respiration {.tabset}
Variation in gene copies in the aerobic respiration module is linked with variation in tropic level, bodyshape, and aspect ratio which determines swimming speed. 
 
##### Expression in Bgee. 
The top five tissues with the highest expression across fishes are generally, muscle tissue, liver, other digestive tissues.


##### Expression during embryonic and post-embryonic development. 
The rapid turnover genes from the aerobic respiration module had expression mainly restricted to the 24 hours post fertilisation (hpf) stage in the zebrafish embryo. During post-embryonic development, their expression was less restricted but was elevated at later stages of development.
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-019, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/", fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
comp_dev_danio_heatmap(system_proc = "Aerobic respiration")
```

##### Expression during metamorphosis
During clownfish metamorphosis, ociad1, micos10,  and atp5med, had expression peaks coinciding with thyroid hormone surges, while atp5pd showed an overall decline with a modest increase at metamorphosis. In grouper, expression generally declined through development but increased following the second thyroid hormone peak.

#### Peroxisome process {.tabset}

These genes are highly expressed in the brain and eye of the different fishes, with moderate expression in gonads.

##### ZFIN data
There is not much genetic perturbation data for genes in the translation module. For the genes with available data I see that genetic perturbation tends to disrupt the embryo, decrease eye formation, affects trunk morphology, and influences swimming quality. There is also evidence of inducing a delay in hatching. 
```{r 10_functional_characterisation-chunk-028, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/10_functional_characterisation/"}
pheno_terms_plot(col = "black")
```

#### Immune system process {.tabset}
Variation in gene copies in the Immune system module is linked with variation in maximum age and body shape.

##### Expression in Bgee
High expression in different tissues due to distribution of sampling. However, the genes are typically expressed at high levels in spleen and head kidney, both of which are involved in the immune cell production. Furthermore, the expression of these immune genes in the pharyngeal gills potentially denotes the presence of gill-associated lymphoid tissues (GIALT) PMID: 32549335.
